description: The 'dss_apps_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about live applications, focusing on their visibility, version, and usage details. This dataset is particularly useful for managing and analyzing applications within a software environment, such as Dataiku. It includes key identifiers like 'appId' and 'appVersion', which help in tracking and managing different versions of applications. The dataset also contains descriptive fields like 'label' and 'shortDesc', offering insights into the purpose and functionality of each application. Additionally, it includes technical details such as 'origin' and 'originProjectKey', which indicate the source and project association of the applications. The 'tags' column provides a way to categorize applications using JSON arrays, enhancing searchability and organization. Boolean fields like 'onlyLimitedVisibility', 'isAppImg', and 'useAsRecipe' offer quick insights into the application's visibility, image availability, and usage as a recipe. The 'instanceCount' column helps in understanding the deployment scale of each application. Overall, this dataset is a valuable resource for application management, providing both high-level and detailed views of live applications.
shortDesc: Dataset of live applications with visibility, version, and usage details.

columns.name: onlyLimitedVisibility
columns.comment: Indicates if app has limited visibility, boolean value.

columns.name: appId
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each application, text format.

columns.name: appVersion
columns.comment: Version information of the application, text format.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Descriptive label for the application, free text.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Short description of the application, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the application, JSON array format.

columns.name: isAppImg
columns.comment: Indicates if app has an image, boolean value.

columns.name: origin
columns.comment: Source of the application, either project or plugin.

columns.name: originProjectKey
columns.comment: Key of the originating project, text format.

columns.name: instanceCount
columns.comment: Number of instances of the application, integer value.

columns.name: useAsRecipe
columns.comment: Indicates if app is used as a recipe, boolean value.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the application, string format.
